messages:
ana: Heads up — I put a new draft up for the product launch post with two asset options: quick highlights + gated deep-dive. Link: https://drive.redwood/infer/launch-draft-new (comments on). Need alignment on benchmark narrative, CTA flow, webinar scheduling, and HS routing by EOD tomorrow.

jamie: jumping in for editorial. I'll trim hero copy and make sure the first fold shows a quick benefit stat. Can we make the headline less technical?

mike: agree on benefit-forward headline. For benchmarks: include a short methods note (HW, token avg, cache on/off). Suggest we call out both chat and streaming numbers.

devon: infra can supply raw CSVs and run IDs. Tentative webinar date options: Tue 6/18 10am PT or Thu 6/20 6pm PT (better for APAC). We'll ask registrants to pick preferred slot.

ana (ana): small correction 11am PT on Tue works better for infra.

lisa: legal quick note: avoid absolutist claims like "fastest". Recommend: "one of the most cost-efficient for latency-sensitive chat workloads". Also include a link to our privacy notice on any form.

ana: good call. We'll use that phrasing. For gated CTA copy draft: "Get the deep-dive benchmark deck 14 runs, configs, and cost breakdowns." Shorten if needed.

mike: tweak: "Download the benchmark deck 14 detailed runs, configs, and cost breakdowns."

jamie: editorial tweak 1: make the charts come earlier so the impact is visible before the product details. Also add a 2-line routing blurb: how requests fallback to lower-cost model variant.

devon: routing blurb: "Smart routing ensures requests meet latency SLOs by routing to compatible variants when primary capacity is constrained." Good?

lisa: fine, add a parenthetical about automatic fallback logs being available in Console for troubleshooting.

publish-bot: Reminder: REVIEW checklist: marketing ✅ | legal pending | product ✅ | infra pending | assets: hero image missing | publish date unset.

ana: timeline: editorial finish tonight, infra upload CSV + run IDs by 9am tomorrow, legal quick-pass by 11am, HS form + hidden field mapping by noon. Design to deliver hero by EOD. Target publish Wed next week if all green.

mike: HS mapping note: hidden field `source=blog_launch` and workflow `launch_deck_registrants`. Dev/ops to confirm SDR queue name.

devon: queue will be `PLG_Launch_Inbound`. I'll confirm. Also uploading CSVs now, will ping when live.

jamie: headline A: "Reduce inference cost without trading latency." Headline B: "Predictable inference for production apps." Leaning A.

lisa: legal prefers A with qualification from earlier.

ana: perfect. I'll post v2 in ~90min with moved charts, gated CTA copy, and the HS form spec. Tagging @lisa and @devon for final uploads. Thanks! :tada:

mike: I'll add notes on demo script for the webinar (2 short demos: cost comparison + routing failover).

devon: happy to run infra demo + handle Qs.

publish-bot: Draft autosaved to /drive/redwood/infer/launch-draft-v2 (link: https://drive.redwood/infer/launch-draft-v2).

jamie: quick nit 1 chart caption needs to note median vs mean. I'll annotate and re-run editorial pass once CSV is attached.

lisa: ping me after CSV attach and I'll do the quick legal sign-off.

ana: thanks team 1 closing for now, will reopen with v2 link.
